blurb: Guests can rent ice time by the hour for youth and adults, participate in public skating sessions, freestyle figure skating, and stick & puck sessions. The Sports Deck at Hockey Town USA offers a multi-sports court for lacrosse, soccer, field hockey, roller hockey, floor hockey, and football. The Boston Bruins Holiday Tournament is an annual event for Mite & Squirt hockey teams with multiple games and awards.
